thread:
anna: Quick sync — planning a dry-run for the launch gate cut on Tue 3/30. Need a fast rollcall and agenda confirmation. Proposed window: 2026-03-30 13:30-14:00 PT. Who's available? @devon @sam @priya

devon: I can make 13:30. Will take 10m to run canary smoke and share perf numbers.

sam: 13:30 works for me too. prefer earlier so we have buffer for rollback checks.

priya: I might be on a call until 13:40 — can dial in late, but if we can do 13:15 -> 13:45 I can be there for most of it.

maya: 13:30 is fine. I will bring the cut checklist and infra owner list.

jordan: +1 for 13:30. I can cover A/B routing and fallback config verification.

anna: OK locking 13:30 then. Quick agenda draft below — please flag owners and any missing items. React with :thumbsup: if this looks good, :warning: if something critical is missing.

```
Agenda (30m dry-run)
1) Rollcall & quick owner intros (3m)
2) Canary smoke results + perf snapshot (7m) — owner: devon
3) Cut checklist walkthrough (8m) — owner: maya
4) Routing/fallback verification (5m) — owner: jordan
5) Rollback & escalation plan (4m) — owner: release lead
6) Open issues & action items (3m)
```

devon: I'll attach the smoke run command + sample logs in thread before the dry-run so everyone can preview: `./smoke_run.sh --canary --tail=100`.

priya: Who's the release lead for this cut? Need to know who signs off if canary looks flaky.

anna: Release lead will be @priya for this window unless she objects. Priya?

priya: I can take the release lead seat. Will coordinate rollback owners with SRE tomorrow.

release-bot: Reminder: release checklist stored at https://redwood.internal/releases/checklists/2026-cut-03-30 — please review before the dry-run.

sam: Noted. I'll skim the checklist and drop any blockers. If anyone expects DB migrations, call it out now.

maya: No migrations in this cut, just model config and routing tweaks.

anna: Can people confirm attendance by EOD today? If 13:30 still stands I'll post calendar invite and a short pre-read with the checklist link.

devon: Confirmed. I'll upload perf snapshot by EOD.

jordan: Confirmed.

priya: Confirmed, I'll prepare rollback owner list.

sam: Confirmed.

anna: Awesome — I'll send invite and a slim pre-read with the agenda + checklist. If you have any hot items to add to the agenda, ping me here. :thumbsup:
